scripts.dev: npm run acoustic:check && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && node .runtime/server/index.js" "vite --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.build: npm run acoustic:check && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.cloud:build: npm run acoustic:check && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && tsc -p tsconfig.addons.json
scripts.test: npm run acoustic:check && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && node --test .runtime/tests/*.test.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
